description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Chromatic Orrery to become a creature.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Chromatic Orrery, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
